question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Follow
solution:
The correct answer is "**Predate**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Follow" means to go or come after someone or something.**(अनुसरण करना)

 
 
• Example: You need to follow the rules of the temple.
 
 
 
• **"Predate" is the opposite of "Follow" and means to come before something in time.**(पहले बन)
 
 
• Example: These cave paintings predate any others which are known.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it can be concluded that the word "predate" is the antonym of the word "follow."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "Ensue", is a synonym of "Follow" as it means to happen or occur as a result of something that came before.(पीछा करना)
 
• Option 3, "Supplant", is also a synonym of "Displace" as it means to replace or take the place of something or someone.(उखाड़ना)
 
• Option 4, "Displace", is the opposite of "Retain" as it means to move something or someone from its original position.(विस्थापित)
